guides.title: Requesting access in Ledger
guides.text: Ask your line manager to approve the request in the Service Portal under Access > Ledger. Project managers get the Project Manager role. Approval takes up to two working days.

guides.title: Requesting access in Ledger
guides.text: Email the finance office to request Ledger access. Approval takes up to ten working days.

guides.title: Signing an NDA
guides.text: Use the standard mutual NDA template from the Legal page. If the customer changes any clause, send the draft to legal@institute.example before signing. Unit managers may sign standard NDAs.

guides.title: Travel booking
guides.text: Book trips through the travel agency portal. Trips abroad need approval from your line manager before booking. Train is the default for trips under 500 km.

guides.title: Reporting a security incident
guides.text: Report lost laptops, phishing or suspicious logins to the security desk at once, day or night. Do not investigate on your own.

guides.title: New customer in Atlas
guides.text: Register new customers in Atlas before sending a quote. Check the company registration number and add a contact person. Quotes above 500 000 SEK need a second reviewer.

guides.title: Working from another country
guides.text: Working from another country for more than 20 days per year needs HR approval because of tax and insurance rules.

guides.title: Climate travel policy
guides.text: Since 1 October 2025, train is the default for trips under 800 km. Flights need a short written reason.
